title: Counit normalization of the site-transported closed adjoint
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $R=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow P$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Write $S_T=\nu_T^*$ and $U_T=R\nu_{T,*}$ for etale/pro-etale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $I=Ri^!_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the ordinary etale closed right adjoint [lem-exc-closed-ambient], and $J=S_Z I U_P$ for the finite transported exceptional functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], identifying the etale compact-support adjoint with $I$ by its counit-compatible adjunction comparison. Give $J$ the bounded-below etale-origin Hom bijections of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] for the identity-open compactification of $i$. Let $H\in D^+(P_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ and suppose $IH\in D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},R)$. Let $\eta_H:H\xrightarrow{\sim}U_PS_PH$ be the specified comparison unit [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], and set
$$\alpha_H=S_ZI(\eta_H):S_ZIH\xrightarrow{\sim}JS_PH.$$
For bounded-below $L$ let $\delta_L:S_Pi_*^{\mathrm{et}}L\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}S_ZL$ be the normalized canonical comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. With $e_H:i_*^{\mathrm{et}}IH\to H$ the etale exceptional counit and $E_{S_PH}:i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}JS_PH\to S_PH$ the transported exceptional counit, one has
$$E_{S_PH}\circ i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}(\alpha_H)\circ\delta_{IH}=S_P(e_H).$$
More generally the transported exceptional adjunct of $S_P(f)\circ\delta_L^{-1}$, for $f:i_*^{\mathrm{et}}L\to H$, is $\alpha_H\circ S_Z(\widehat f)$, where $\widehat f:L\to IH$ is the etale exceptional adjunct.

proof.text: Write $F=i_*^{\mathrm{et}}$ and $P=i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}$. The ordinary adjunction $F\dashv I$ is [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. By [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], the site-comparison unit $\eta_H:H\to U_PS_PH$ is an isomorphism. $I(\eta_H)$ is an isomorphism $IH\to IU_PS_PH$, so the latter ordinary etale object is bounded below as well. Functoriality therefore makes $\alpha_H=S_ZI(\eta_H)$ an isomorphism, with target $JS_PH=S_ZIU_PS_PH$ by [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Its source $S_ZIH$ is bounded below by exact derived pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Consequently $JS_PH$ is also bounded below and has the etale-origin witness $(IH,\alpha_H)$. Thus the relative Hom bijection stipulated in the item can be evaluated with source $JS_PH$, which is needed to define its counit. This only uses the stated hypothesis $IH\in D^+$, not constructibility.

proof.text:
Let $\beta_{L,N}:\operatorname{Hom}(FL,N)\to\operatorname{Hom}(L,IN)$ denote the ordinary exceptional adjunction bijection. Unpack the transported bijection of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] with the identity etale-origin witness for $S_ZL$, as specified in [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. For the identity-open compactification the open-extension comparison is the identity, so the canonical compact-support comparison of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] is the inverse of the named direct-image mate $\delta_L$ of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. Thus the bijection is the following chain:
$$\begin{aligned}
\operatorname{Hom}(PS_ZL,S_PH)&\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}(S_PFL,S_PH)\\
g&\longmapsto g\circ\delta_L,\\
\operatorname{Hom}(S_PFL,S_PH)&\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}(FL,U_PS_PH)\\
a&\longmapsto U_P(a)\circ\eta_{FL},\\
\operatorname{Hom}(FL,U_PS_PH)&\xrightarrow{\beta_{L,U_PS_PH}}\operatorname{Hom}(L,IU_PS_PH)\\
b&\longmapsto\beta_{L,U_PS_PH}(b),\\
\operatorname{Hom}(L,IU_PS_PH)&\xrightarrow{S_Z}\operatorname{Hom}(S_ZL,JS_PH).
\end{aligned}$$
The second arrow is the comparison adjunction and the last is full faithfulness [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. Denote the composite by $\Phi_L$. The ordinary adjoint identification with $I$ is the counit-compatible identification stipulated in the item. The assumed bounded-below domains are exactly those of these specified bijections.

proof.text:
For $f:FL\to H$ set $g=S_P(f)\circ\delta_L^{-1}$. The first arrow of Step 2 gives $g\circ\delta_L=S_P(f)$. Naturality of the unit of [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] gives
$$U_PS_P(f)\circ\eta_{FL}=\eta_H\circ f.$$
Naturality in the target of the ordinary adjunction [lem-exc-closed-ambient] gives
$$\beta_{L,U_PS_PH}(\eta_H\circ f)=I(\eta_H)\circ\beta_{L,H}(f)=I(\eta_H)\circ\widehat f.$$
Applying $S_Z$ and functoriality, the last arrow of Step 2 gives
$$\Phi_L(S_P(f)\circ\delta_L^{-1})=S_Z(I(\eta_H))\circ S_Z(\widehat f)=\alpha_H\circ S_Z(\widehat f).$$
This proves the general adjunct formula by substitution in the defining Hom chain; no exceptional-counit identity is assumed in this calculation.

proof.text:
Set $L=IH$ and $f=e_H$. The defining counit property of $F\dashv I$ [lem-exc-closed-ambient] is $\beta_{IH,H}(e_H)=1_{IH}$. Step 3 therefore gives
$$\Phi_{IH}(S_P(e_H)\circ\delta_{IH}^{-1})=\alpha_H.$$
By definition, the relative counit $E=E_{S_PH}$ has transpose $1_{JS_PH}$ under the stipulated Hom bijection. It is defined because Step 1 supplies a bounded-below etale-origin witness for $JS_PH$. Naturality in the source of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class], applied to $\alpha_H:S_ZIH\to JS_PH$, gives
$$\Phi_{IH}(E\circ P(\alpha_H))=1_{JS_PH}\circ\alpha_H=\alpha_H.$$
Injectivity of this Hom bijection identifies $E\circ P(\alpha_H)$ with $S_P(e_H)\circ\delta_{IH}^{-1}$. Precompose with $\delta_{IH}$ and cancel its inverse to obtain
$$E_{S_PH}\circ i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}(\alpha_H)\circ\delta_{IH}=S_P(e_H).$$
The general formula was proved in Step 3, so both clauses follow.
